questions.question: Confirm Monge’s birth date. The post gives 10 May 1746, as do the BnF catalogue and French Senate; MacTutor and the archival biography on Annales give 9 May, with the latter citing the birth record. The author’s 10 May is retained in both versions pending a decision; the separate original publication date, 12 May, remains unchanged. Sources: https://catalogue.bnf.fr/ark%3A/12148/cb121412336 ; https://www.senat.fr/pair-de-france/monge_gaspardpf1059.html ; https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Monge/ ; https://annales.org/archives/x/monge1.html .

localizations.ru: Уточнить день рождения Монжа: пост даёт 10 мая 1746 года, как каталог BnF и французский Сенат, но MacTutor и архивная биография на Annales дают 9 мая; последний текст ссылается на акт рождения. questions.resolution: Corrected to 9 May 1746 from the baptism record in the Beaune Municipal Archives (série 1 GG), reproduced by the Centre Beaunois d’Études Historiques; the record states that Monge was born that same day.
